query.text: 请帮我留意老人出门的安全，有风险或不安全的行为时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please watch for the older person’s safety when going outside and alert me to risks or unsafe behavior.

annotation.text_zh: 您没穿鞋，请不要直接走到室外。
annotation.text_en: You're not wearing shoes. Please don't go outside barefoot.
